concept: CloudFront: global delivery of static content from an S3 origin
tests: How to give global users low latency and high availability for a static site and protect the origin from overload.
expected: CloudFront with an S3 origin — caching at edge locations, offloading the origin. Triggers: "globally distributed users", "static website", "low latency", "protection against origin overload".
why_not: Serving directly from S3 — no edge cache; a single EC2 — neither global nor HA; Route 53 latency routing to one server doesn't reduce latency.
